name: Okta users, groups and app assignments
description: Okta identity inventory: one feed each for the org's users, group memberships, application assignments, applications and groups, as Splunk_TA_okta_identity_cloud indexes them. Snapshot tables, not an event log: each row is the current state of one user, membership, assignment, app or group.
source: Okta Management API User, Group and AppUser schemas (okta-management-openapi-spec); Splunk_TA_okta_identity_cloud field extraction and lookup enrichment, observed in a seeded dev index. Application and Group schemas (okta-management-openapi-spec) for the app and group inventory containers.

feed.label: Okta identity inventory
feed.description: Okta's own record of who exists, which groups they belong to and which apps they are assigned, one row per user, membership or assignment rather than one row per event.

user_id.label: Okta user id
user_id.description: Okta's own unique key for the user; stable across profile and login changes.

user_login.label: Login
user_login.description: The user's unique sign-in identifier, almost always formatted as an email address.

user_second_email.label: Secondary email
user_second_email.description: A backup email address used for account recovery, separate from the primary email.

user_display_name.label: Display name
user_display_name.description: A human-readable label for the user. Observed as the first and last name joined with a space; this is the TA's own computed value, not a literal Okta API field.

user_primary_phone.label: Primary phone
user_primary_phone.description: The user's primary phone number, for example a home number.

user_street_address.label: Street address
user_street_address.description: The street address component of the user's address.

user_city.label: City
user_city.description: The city or locality component of the user's address.

user_state.label: State or region
user_state.description: The state or region component of the user's address.

user_country_code.label: Country code
user_country_code.description: The two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) of the user's address.

user_zip_code.label: Zip or postal code
user_zip_code.description: The zip or postal code component of the user's address.

user_status.label: User status
user_status.description: The Okta account's current lifecycle status.

user_type_id.label: User type id
user_type_id.description: The id of the schema (User Type) that shapes this user's profile.

credential_provider_type.label: Credential provider type
credential_provider_type.description: Which kind of identity provider validates the user's password credential.

credential_provider_name.label: Credential provider name
credential_provider_name.description: The name of the authentication provider, for example the literal OKTA for Okta-managed passwords.

user_created_time.label: Account created
user_created_time.description: When the Okta user account was created.

user_activated_time.label: Account activated
user_activated_time.description: When the user's status last transitioned to ACTIVE.

user_status_changed_time.label: Account status changed
user_status_changed_time.description: When the user's status last changed.

user_last_login_time.label: Last login
user_last_login_time.description: The timestamp of the user's last login.

user_last_updated_time.label: Account last updated
user_last_updated_time.description: When the user record was last updated.

user_password_changed_time.label: Password last changed
user_password_changed_time.description: When the user's password was last changed.

group_id.label: Group id
group_id.description: Okta's unique id for the group.

group_name.label: Group name
group_name.description: The group's display name, or (on OktaIM2:user) the set of group names the user belongs to.

group_type.label: Group type
group_type.description: How the group's profile and memberships are managed.

group_membership_updated_time.label: Group membership last updated
group_membership_updated_time.description: When the group's memberships were last changed.

app_id.label: App id
app_id.description: Okta's unique id for the application instance.

app_name.label: App key name
app_name.description: The app's internal key name; for catalog apps this is the unique key for the app definition.

app_user_external_id.label: App user external id
app_user_external_id.description: The id of this person in the target app itself, set once provisioning confirms or creates them there. Not an Okta id, even though it can look like one.

app_user_created_time.label: App assignment created
app_user_created_time.description: When this user's assignment to the app was created.

app_user_last_updated_time.label: App assignment last updated
app_user_last_updated_time.description: When this user's app assignment record was last updated.

app_user_status_changed_time.label: App assignment status changed
app_user_status_changed_time.description: When this user's app assignment status last changed.

app_user_scope.label: App assignment scope
app_user_scope.description: Whether the app assignment is direct or came from group membership.

app_user_status.label: App assignment status
app_user_status.description: The application user's own provisioning status, separate from the Okta account status.

app_credential_username.label: App credential username
app_credential_username.description: The username this person signs in with inside the target app, which can differ from their Okta login.

assignment_sync_outcome.label: Assignment sync outcome
assignment_sync_outcome.description: A generic success or failure flag on the app assignment row. Observed as a fixed literal, not documented by the Okta API; do not confuse with the Okta AppUserStatus value, which lands on the result column on this container.

change_action.label: Change action tag
change_action.description: A generic change-tracking action label the TA adds to app assignment rows. Observed fixed at one literal in this deployment; not an Okta API field.

change_type_tag.label: Change type tag
change_type_tag.description: A generic change-tracking category label. Observed as a value that does not describe an app assignment; likely an uncustomized default, not something to filter on.

change_object_category.label: Changed object category
change_object_category.description: What kind of object the generic change tag says changed.

change_object_attrs.label: Changed object attribute
change_object_attrs.description: Which attribute the generic change tag says changed.

cim_host_artifact.label: CIM host field
cim_host_artifact.description: A generic device or destination host field. In this deployment it carries the sample-seeding source name, not a real Okta or tenant value; left without an example for that reason.

vendor_product.label: Vendor product
vendor_product.description: A fixed literal naming the vendor product, for CIM tagging.

accessible_apps.label: Accessible apps
accessible_apps.description: A multivalue list naming the apps this user can access. Not populated in the seeded sample; meaning inferred from the field name and the parallel group_name/memberof_groups fields.

app_status.label: App status
app_status.description: The application instance's own lifecycle status, separate from any user's assignment status.

app_sign_on_mode.label: Sign-on mode
app_sign_on_mode.description: How Okta authenticates users into this app: a bookmark, SWA form-fill, SAML, OIDC, WS-Federation, and so on.

app_created_time.label: App created
app_created_time.description: When the application object was created.

app_last_updated_time.label: App last updated
app_last_updated_time.description: When the application object was last updated.

app_orn.label: App resource name (ORN)
app_orn.description: The Okta resource name for this app instance, a colon-delimited path naming the org, the resource type and the app id.

app_features.label: Enabled features
app_features.description: A multivalue list of provisioning and SSO features this app instance has enabled, drawn from a large fixed catalog (GROUP_PUSH, IMPORT_NEW_USERS, SSO and so on).

app_universal_logout_status.label: Universal Logout status
app_universal_logout_status.description: Whether this app instance supports and has enabled Universal Logout, Okta's cross-app sign-out feature.

app_credential_scheme.label: Credential vaulting scheme
app_credential_scheme.description: How Okta vaults the shared credential for a BASIC_AUTH, BROWSER_PLUGIN or SECURE_PASSWORD_STORE app; absent for other sign-on modes.

app_credential_signing_kid.label: Signing key id
app_credential_signing_kid.description: The key identifier used for signing assertions on this app's federated sign-on.

app_username_template.label: Username mapping expression
app_username_template.description: The Okta Expression Language expression used to generate the username Okta pushes into this app when assigning a user.

app_username_template_type.label: Username mapping type
app_username_template_type.description: Whether the username mapping expression is Okta's built-in default, a custom expression, or unset.

app_accessibility_self_service.label: Self-service assignable
app_accessibility_self_service.description: Whether users can self-assign this app.

app_accessibility_error_redirect_url.label: Error redirect URL
app_accessibility_error_redirect_url.description: A custom error page URL for the app.

app_accessibility_login_redirect_url.label: Login redirect URL
app_accessibility_login_redirect_url.description: A custom login page URL for the app; deprecated on Identity Engine orgs in favor of IdP routing rules.

app_visibility_auto_launch.label: Auto-launch
app_visibility_auto_launch.description: Whether Okta automatically signs the user into this app when they sign into Okta.

app_visibility_auto_submit_toolbar.label: Auto-submit on landing
app_visibility_auto_submit_toolbar.description: Whether Okta automatically signs the user in when they land on the app's sign-in page.

app_visibility_hide.label: Hidden on end-user surface
app_visibility_hide.description: Whether the app tile is hidden on a specific end-user surface (Okta Mobile on iOS or Android, or the web End-User Dashboard); which surface depends on the column bound.

app_visibility_link_enabled.label: Dashboard link enabled
app_visibility_link_enabled.description: Whether a named link or icon (admin, login or workflow_login) appears on the End-User Dashboard for this app.

app_em_opt_in_status.label: Entitlement management opt-in status
app_em_opt_in_status.description: The app's opt-in state for Okta's entitlement management feature.

app_implicit_assignment.label: Implicit assignment enabled
app_implicit_assignment.description: Whether Okta automatically assigns users to this app based on their role or group membership, rather than an explicit assignment.

app_manual_provisioning.label: Manual provisioning
app_manual_provisioning.description: Whether this app instance is configured for manual (not automated) user provisioning; the name and false/true shape are observed, the property is not declared on the base Application or ApplicationSettings schemas this pack read.

app_notes_admin.label: Admin note
app_notes_admin.description: A free-text app message visible to admins.

app_notes_enduser.label: End-user note
app_notes_enduser.description: A free-text message visible to the user on the End-User Dashboard.

app_vpn_help_url.label: VPN help URL
app_vpn_help_url.description: An optional URL to a help page assisting end users in connecting to the required VPN before using this app.

app_vpn_message.label: VPN requirement message
app_vpn_message.description: A message shown to users when a VPN connection is required for this app.

app_vpn_network_connection.label: VPN notification condition
app_vpn_network_connection.description: When Okta shows the VPN connection notice for this app, based on the client's network.

app_login_setting.label: Sign-on launch setting
app_login_setting.description: A sign-on launch value for this app (a form field name, a launch or redirect URL, a service domain); which one and what it means depends on the app's own sign-on mode, each documented on its own Settings.app schema rather than one shared schema.

app_saml_attribute_statements.label: SAML attribute statements
app_saml_attribute_statements.description: Custom attribute statements Okta adds to this app's SAML assertion.

app_saml_relay_state.label: SAML relay state
app_saml_relay_state.description: Identifies a specific app resource to send the user to in an IdP-initiated sign-on.

app_saml_casb_override.label: SAML CASB override
app_saml_casb_override.description: Overrides a SAML assertion attribute (audience, destination, recipient or ACS URL) for a CASB reverse-proxy configuration in front of this app; empty unless a CASB fronts it.

api_link_href.label: API link
api_link_href.description: A discoverable API URL Okta returns alongside this record, pointing at a related endpoint (the record itself, its groups or users, its logo, a lifecycle action); the org's own API host, not app or group data.

api_link_meta.label: API link label
api_link_meta.description: A name, media type or allowed-method hint describing one of the API links above (for example a logo size, a MIME type, or an HTTP verb the link allows).

group_last_updated_time.label: Group profile last updated
group_last_updated_time.description: When the group's profile was last updated; separate from when its memberships last changed.

group_object_class.label: Group object class
group_object_class.description: Determines which profile shape the group carries: an Okta-native group profile or an Active Directory one.

group_members_list.label: Group members
group_members_list.description: A list naming the group's member users; meaning inferred from the field name and the parallel accessible_apps field, not populated in the seeded data.

ad_windows_group_type.label: Windows group category
ad_windows_group_type.description: The Active Directory group category (for example Security or Distribution) of an AD-imported group. Not the same field as the group's own Okta type.

ad_group_scope.label: Windows group scope
ad_group_scope.description: The Active Directory scope of an AD-imported group (for example Global).

ad_object_sid.label: Windows security identifier (SID)
ad_object_sid.description: The Windows security identifier of an AD-imported group.

ad_distinguished_name.label: Distinguished name
ad_distinguished_name.description: The Windows distinguished name of an AD-imported group.

ad_sam_account_name.label: SAM account name
ad_sam_account_name.description: The pre-Windows-2000 name of an AD-imported group.

ad_windows_domain_qualified_name.label: Domain-qualified name
ad_windows_domain_qualified_name.description: The fully qualified domain\name form of an AD-imported group's name.

ad_external_id.label: AD external id
ad_external_id.description: The base64-encoded objectGUID of an AD-imported group; the AD source's own id for the group, not an Okta id.

OktaIM2:user.description: One record per Okta user object: the account's own profile and lifecycle state, indexed by Splunk_TA_okta_identity_cloud from the Users API.
OktaIM2:user.note: profile, type and credentials are nested objects flattened to dotted field names by INDEXED_EXTRACTIONS = json. group_name, memberof_groups, app_name and app_label are search-time lookup enrichment, not raw fields.

OktaIM2:groupUser.description: One record per group membership: which user belongs to which group, from the Group API's list member users operation.
OktaIM2:groupUser.note: The raw event carries only groupid, groupName, userid, userName and lastMembershipUpdated; every profile field (email, name, address, status, lifecycle timestamps) is search-time lookup enrichment joined by user id against the OktaIM2:user data.

OktaIM2:appUser.description: One record per application-user assignment: which user is assigned to which app, at what scope and status, from the app's list application users operation.
OktaIM2:appUser.note: The raw event carries appid, appName, appLabel, userid, externalId, userName, created, lastUpdated, statusChanged, scope and status. Every other observed column is search-time enrichment: member profile fields looked up by user id, and a set of generic CIM change-tracking fields (action, change_type, object, object_category, object_id, object_attrs, dvc) the TA or this deployment adds; status on this container is that generic tag's outcome flag, not the Okta AppUserStatus value, which lands on result instead.

OktaIM2:app.description: One record per Okta application instance: its own configuration, sign-on mode, credentials, visibility and lifecycle status, from the Application API's list applications operation.
OktaIM2:app.note: accessibility, credentials, features, links, settings, universalLogout and visibility are nested objects flattened to dotted field names by INDEXED_EXTRACTIONS = json. serial and app_id are search-time CIM identity aliases of id; description is a search-time CIM alias equal to label, not a literal Application field. settings.app.* and settings.signOn.* vary by signOnMode; this pack folds the sign-on-launch and SAML-override fields into shared concepts rather than one per app type.

OktaIM2:group.description: One record per Okta group: its profile, membership-update time and Active Directory import details where the group is AD-sourced, from the Group API's list groups operation.
OktaIM2:group.note: profile is a nested object flattened to dotted field names by INDEXED_EXTRACTIONS = json; its shape differs for an Okta-native group (name, description) and an AD-imported one (adds dn, externalId, groupScope, groupType, objectSid, samAccountName, windowsDomainQualifiedName). serial is a search-time CIM identity alias of id; description is a search-time CIM alias of profile.description. user and user_name are misleadingly named CIM aliases that carry the group's own name, not a user identity; group_name is a search-time alias of profile.name, not populated in the seeded event.

ids_look_alike.text: Okta id prefixes look alike but name different resources: 00u is a user, 00g is a group, 0oa is an app. An externalId is the linked app's own id for the person, not an Okta id, even when it is shaped like one.

names_not_stable.text: A login or username is usually an email address; it survives a display name change but not a login or email change, and a username inside a target app can differ from the person's Okta login.

index_time_is_ingest_time.text: On this container Splunk's own _time is when the event was indexed, not any timestamp in the record; filter and sort on the timestamp fields, not on time range.

cim_artifact.text: This field is a generic CIM tag the TA or this deployment adds, not a value the Okta API documents; treat its meaning as observed, not vendor-confirmed.

app_time_is_last_change.text: On OktaIM2:app, props.conf sets TIME_PREFIX = lastUpdated, so _time is when the app object's configuration last changed, not when this row was captured; use it to sort by recency of change, not to bound a capture window.

ad_group_profile_undocumented.text: profile.groupType, profile.groupScope and profile.objectSid appear in Okta's own list-groups example payload (management-minimal.yaml) but are not declared properties of the current OktaActiveDirectoryGroupProfile schema; treat them as observed, not vendor-confirmed.

windows_group_type_look_alike.text: profile.groupType (a Windows/AD group category such as Security or Distribution) is not the same field as the top-level type (Okta's own OKTA_GROUP, APP_GROUP or BUILT_IN classification); the similar name invites confusing the two.

group_user_field_is_group_name.text: The columns named user and user_name on OktaIM2:group carry the group's own display name, not a user identity; a CIM alias artifact, not an Okta API field.

ad_group_id_systems.text: profile.objectSid (a Windows SID) and profile.externalId (a base64-encoded AD objectGUID) are further identifiers for the same Windows group, in different formats again; neither is an Okta id despite sitting on an Okta group record.
